name: Equity
definition: Last journaled equity of the newest paper session

name: Cash
definition: Cash on the same equity row

name: Realised P&L
definition: Realised P&L of the session (partial-sell aware)

name: Unrealised P&L
definition: Mark-to-market P&L of open positions

name: Drawdown from peak
definition: Drawdown from the running peak: the series the kill-switch reads

name: Invested share
definition: Positions value as a share of equity

name: Fills (24 h)
definition: Fills with a fill time in the 24 h before the snapshot

name: Kill-switch tripped
definition: 1 when state/HALTED exists; 0 when clear

name: Gate rejections (24 h)
definition: Intents the router rejected in the last 24 h

name: Gate rejections (journal)
definition: Every row in the rejection journal (spans sessions)

name: Pending prompts
definition: Unresolved intents whose TTL has not run out

name: Accepted
definition: Intents the card ACCEPTED

name: Declined
definition: Intents the card DECLINED

name: Expired
definition: Intents that ran out of TTL unanswered

name: Median card response
definition: Median issue-to-decision time over decided prompts (expired excluded)

name: Headlines (24 h)
definition: Headlines the live collector journaled in the last 24 h

name: Title-mapped share (24 h)
definition: Share of those headlines that name a basket symbol in the title

name: Feeds healthy
definition: Feeds whose last fetch succeeded

name: Feeds failing
definition: Feeds in back-off after a failed fetch

name: Collector heartbeat age
definition: Minutes since the collector's last pass

name: GKG files (24 h)
definition: 15-minute GKG files fetched for the last 24 h (96 is complete)

name: Articles scanned (24 h)
definition: Articles in those files

name: Articles kept (24 h)
definition: Articles naming a basket symbol in title or organisations

name: Crawl coverage (24 h)
definition: Share of the last 24 hours with at least one file

name: History span
definition: Days between the oldest and newest file held

name: Backfill transfer
definition: Bytes the backfill has transferred against its 75 GB budget

name: Energy (abnormal)
definition: Energy share of all GKG articles vs its prior 28 days

name: Conflict (abnormal)
definition: Conflict share of all GKG articles vs its prior 28 days

name: Military (abnormal)
definition: Military share of all GKG articles vs its prior 28 days

name: Economy (abnormal)
definition: Economy share of all GKG articles vs its prior 28 days

name: Disaster (abnormal)
definition: Disaster share of all GKG articles vs its prior 28 days

name: Crypto scalar
definition: De-risk multiplier for crypto in the last non-empty snapshot

name: Equity scalar
definition: De-risk multiplier for equities

name: Commodity scalar
definition: De-risk multiplier for commodities

name: Strategic risk
definition: WorldMonitor geopolitical index

name: Fear and greed
definition: Market fear and greed reading

name: Feed degraded
definition: 1 when the snapshot was built from a partial fetch

name: Edges held
definition: Edges in the graph journal after washing

name: Edges written (24 h)
definition: Edges stamped in the last 24 h

name: News mentions (24 h)
definition: event-mentions-symbol edges in the last 24 h

name: Own-activity share (7 d)
definition: Share of edges that are the book's own trades: removed by the adapter

name: Feature rows
definition: Symbol-day rows in the point-in-time store

name: Newest row age
definition: Days between the newest row's date and the snapshot

name: Built live
definition: Rows frozen within 2 h of their cutoff (the rest are rebuilds)

name: Graph-adapter coverage
definition: Rows with a known gx_stress_exposure

name: Risk labels
definition: Matured 5-day drawdown labels

name: Verdicts tested
definition: (lens rule) pairs scored on the training dates

name: Verdicts passed
definition: Pairs with rho > 0 and raw p < 0.05 (no FDR correction)

name: Expected by chance
definition: Passes expected if no lens had any signal (tested x 0.05)

name: Fused holdout rho
definition: Rank correlation of the fused score with realised drawdown on the holdout

name: Veto drawdown gap
definition: Mean drawdown of vetoed minus kept holdout events

name: Spent
definition: Settled simulation spend

name: Reserved
definition: Caps held by seeds awaiting a result

name: Left of $100
definition: Credit not yet spent or reserved

name: Runs ingested
definition: Simulation runs ingested

name: Last run age
definition: Hours since the last run was ingested (stances expire at 168)

name: Last run agents
definition: Agents in the last ingested run

name: Last run symbols
definition: Symbols the last society held a stance on
